title: Current Source Editor baseline
summary: The accepted delivered baseline remains oorexx_source_editor_v0.1-dev5. Git now contains a dev7 candidate: dev6 routes backup/live publication through oorexx.atomic-file/0.1 dev1 with FULL durability requested, and dev7 adds native ooRexx SourceEditorCliSearchArgs so multi-word find/grep expressions survive the flattened command tail via explicit --mode/--case switches. Rasen Falcon REQ-00000589 returned NOT_RUN because the qualifier lacked the exact checkout plus Atomic File closure; dev7 therefore remains candidate-only pending fresh r13196/native-provider qualification.
invariants: Implementation remains native ooRexx; do not move semantic ownership into Python.
Literal find stays literal; regex grep uses ooRexx RegularExpression semantics.
Recursive file traversal uses ooRexx/RexxUtil facilities rather than an external find subprocess.
Source results retain original path/line/column and enclosing-symbol provenance where available.
User-visible completion order is deterministic and must not depend on Directory iteration order.
Dev7 must not be called accepted until the full r13196 + Atomic File native-provider suite passes.
